description: This file defines an interface for grain base behavior in Orleans, including methods for activation, deactivation, and extension methods for managing grain timers and migration. It also includes an enumeration for deactivation reasons and extension methods for error checking.

classes.name: IGrainBase
classes.description: Interface for grain implementations, providing methods for activation and deactivation, and a property to get the grain context.

classes.name: GrainBaseExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for IGrainBase, including timer creation and migration helpers.

classes.name: DeactivationReasonCode
classes.description: Enumeration of reason codes for grain deactivation events.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Method to handle grain activation override.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Method to handle grain deactivation override.

methods.name: DeactivateOnIdle
methods.description: Extension method to deactivate the grain after current method completes.

methods.name: MigrateOnIdle
methods.description: Extension method to migrate grain during idle.

methods.name: RegisterGrainTimer
methods.description: Various overloaded extension methods to create and register grain timers with different callback signatures and options.
